description: This file defines a migration class for updating the database schema in a specific version of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It handles schema changes such as modifying column types and managing foreign key constraints during the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class that manages database schema migrations for version 4.3.3 of OrangeHRM. It includes methods to apply schema changes, resolve foreign key conflicts, and update columns.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration, including conflict resolution and schema updates such as altering column types and auto-increment settings.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '4.3.3'.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Identifies foreign key constraints in specific tables that conflict with the intended schema changes, to handle their removal and recreation.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Removes foreign key constraints that conflict with schema changes before modifications.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Reinstates foreign key constraints after schema modifications are complete.
